findings.title: Hardcoded list of checks duplicates removed constant
findings.body: The removed constant `CHECK_NAMES` was the single source of truth for the checks list. Replacing it with an inline array literal duplicates the values and breaks the DRY principle. The new list is also harder to maintain and test.
findings.suggestion:
const CHECK_NAMES = ["lint", "typecheck", "test"] as const;

findings.title: Unnecessary JSX fragment for single list item
findings.body: Each `<li>` is rendered directly inside the `<ul>`, so the surrounding `<li>` tags are sufficient. The new code does not use a fragment (`<>...</>`) and therefore does not need the extra nesting. This makes the markup slightly more verbose than necessary.

summary.problem: The change hardcodes the checks list inline instead of reusing the removed constant, reducing maintainability and violating DRY.
summary.done_well: The new list preserves the original order and values, and the component remains simple and focused.
